title: The Wall Reflection Contradiction
description:
Witness A: 'I stood in the hallway and saw the killer's face reflected in the brick wall mirror.'
Architecture Report: The hallway brick wall contains zero mirrors.
question: Which witness is lying?
acceptable_answer_format:
Type only the witness name.

Example:
Witness A
hints: There are no mirrors on the hallway brick wall.
solution_explanation: The architecture report confirms the hallway brick wall contains zero mirrors. Witness A lied about seeing a reflection.
